title: 4.4 There Is and There Are
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Use there is for one thing and there are for two or more, in rooms and with the Unit 2 counting photos.
grammar_function: There is + a + singular noun; there are + number + plural noun; a location phrase from 4.3.
prerequisite: 4.1-4.3 rooms, home objects and place words; 2.6-2.7 numbers and plurals.
speaking_outcome: Say what there is in a room and how many things there are.
